anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved: After, like Before, stops at precondition 1 with no fetch/rebase/push, names the missing helper facility as the reason, closes the sync stage as failed, dispatches no helpers, and explicitly says it does not run any helper's duty in its own context. The one drift worth watching is that After emits a `Verdict: not ready - ...` line even though it states step 3 never ran, whereas Before deliberately said no `Verdict:` line renders on a terminal stop; a reader could take an orchestrator-authored verdict as the orchestrator assessing the PR in its own context, which brushes against f4. Since the Change is about the batch-summary round (one PR's report and menu per turn), it should not touch the single-PR terminal-stop path at all; keep the Before wording that a terminal stop prints only the reason/sync line plus the menu and suppresses `Verdict:`/`Role`/`Delivers`, and scope the new per-turn sequencing text strictly to the batch summary section so this case's output stays byte-for-byte on the Before shape.
